items.title: Ben Affleck is an AI nerd, and the internet is impressed
items.summary: Ben Affleck is going viral for his deep knowledge of AI, from neural networks and transformers to open weights. The actor, who sold his AI filmmaking startup to Netflix earlier this year, is proving he's more than just a Hollywood star.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1B valuation in 10 months
items.summary: The company behind the popular LMArena leaderboard has raised $200 million led by Lightspeed and Khosla, and is now measuring AI models on alignment issues such as lying.
items.creator: Julie Bort

items.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
items.summary: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.
items.creator: Lucas Ropek

items.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
items.summary: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
items.summary: Anthropic's updated usage policy explicitly prohibits users from repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases, though ordinary frustration and criticism are still allowed. The new rules also address election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance.
items.creator: Russell Brandom

items.title: OpenAI’s math solutions aren’t meeting the field’s standards yet
items.summary: OpenAI's flood of proofs deviated from the guidelines set by a group of mathematical researchers consulted by the frontier lab.
items.creator: Tim Fernholz
